
```{r}
ads_Index <- read_excel("~/Desktop/ADS_Index_Most_Current_Vintage (2).xlsx")
```

```{r}
# Assuming ads_Index is your data frame and date is the column with date characters
ads_Index$date <- as.Date(ads_Index$...1, format="%Y:%m:%d")

ads_Index$ads_3month <- rollmean(ads_Index$ADS_Index, 90, fill=NA, align='right')

ads_Index$ads_3month_change <- c(NA, diff(ads_Index$ads_3month))

ads_Index = ads_Index[, -c(1,2)]

ads_Index = na.omit(ads_Index)

ads_Index = ads_Index[, -2]
```

```{r}
write.csv(ads_Index, file = "ads_Index.csv", row.names = F)
```

```{r}
nasdaq_and_interest <- read_csv("fredgraph.csv", show_col_types = F)
```

```{r}
nasdaq_and_interest$date = as.Date(nasdaq_and_interest$date, format="%Y/%m/%d")
```

```{r}
nasdaq_close = read_csv("nasdaq_close.csv", show_col_types = F)

nasdaq_close$date = as.Date(nasdaq_close$date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

nasdaq_close$nasdaq_close = as.numeric(nasdaq_close$nasdaq_close)
```

```{r}
nasdaq_close = na.omit(nasdaq_close)
```

```{r}
library(TTR)
library(quantmod)

nasdaq_close$rsi <- RSI(nasdaq_close$nasdaq_close, n=10)
nasdaq_close$ema <- EMA(nasdaq_close$nasdaq_close, n=20)
nasdaq_close$sma <- SMA(nasdaq_close$nasdaq_close, n=20)
nasdaq_close$macd <- MACD(nasdaq_close$nasdaq_close)
nasdaq_close$stoc_fastk =  stoch(nasdaq_close$nasdaq_close)[, 1]
nasdaq_close$stoc_slowd =  stoch(nasdaq_close$nasdaq_close)[, 3]
nasdaq_close$stoc_fastd =  stoch(nasdaq_close$nasdaq_close)[, 2]
```

```{r}
process_data = ads_Index %>%
  left_join(nasdaq_and_interest, by = "date")
```

```{r}
process_data = nasdaq_close %>%
  left_join(process_data, by = "date")
```

```{r}
process_data = na.omit(process_data)
```

```{r}
process_data = process_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-nasdaq_close)
```

```{r}
process_data = process_data %>%
  mutate(nasdaq_prch = 100*(nasdaq_p - lag(nasdaq_p))/lag(nasdaq_p))
```

```{r}
process_data = process_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-nasdaq_p)
```

```{r}
process_data = na.omit(process_data)
```

```{r}
write.csv(process_data, file = "weekly-nasdaq-return-project.csv", row.names = F)
```
